title: kramastotra — kram-p05-v05
question: Shaking off the standing of bondage-conceit-paths, relishing this, with difference burnt in the fire of endless praise — from the rushing start of varied self-swelling shining glory, drinking things — O giver — mad-intoxicated am I, blissful.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). Shaking off the standing of bondage-conceit-paths, relishing this, with difference burnt in the fire of endless praise — from the rushing start of varied self-swelling shining glory, drinking things — O giver — mad-intoxicated am I, blissful.
